observed: Current official release table lists only Qwen3-TTS-Tokenizer-12Hz and 12Hz 0.6B/1.7B model variants as released/downloadable.
The README states other models mentioned in the technical report will be released in the future.
Released 12Hz models list German among ten supported languages and mark streaming support.

The project describes the 12Hz dual-track architecture as capable of first audio after one input character and reports end-to-end synthesis latency as low as 97 ms; this is an upstream claim, not Frankenstein target-runtime evidence.
The vLLM-Omni section currently states offline inference only, with online serving to be supported later.
Official 12Hz 0.6B CustomVoice checkpoint is Apache-2.0, German-capable, and currently available.
The checkpoint tree is approximately 2.5 GB total; model.safetensors is approximately 1.81 GB.
Official model card reports streaming-oriented low-latency capability but does not establish latency on clay-direct-dev.

upstream_german_customvoice_wer.interpretation_boundary: These are upstream benchmark values, not measurements on Frankenstein prompts, voices, audio transport, hardware, or target runtime.

finding.statement: The lowest-size currently released official Qwen3-TTS path for Frankenstein is 12Hz 0.6B, but Qwen's own German evaluation shows a substantial content-consistency gap versus 12Hz 1.7B, while the report's 25Hz variants score better on German but are not in the current official released-model table. Therefore model size/tokenizer frequency cannot be selected from latency claims alone.

counterhypotheses: The upstream German WER gap may not reproduce on Frankenstein's short conversational German prompts.
12Hz 0.6B may still win system utility if its target-hardware first-audio latency and memory footprint materially beat 1.7B while remaining intelligible.
A Base voice-clone checkpoint may better satisfy stable German male acoustic identity than CustomVoice despite similar parameter count; this requires a separate controlled target-runtime test.
Future official 25Hz releases may change the frontier and should be re-entered when weights are actually available.

next_discriminator.prerequisite: Obtain a real clay-direct-dev hardware/runtime receipt; do not infer target compatibility from queued GitHub Actions or source availability.
fixed_test: Same German prompt set and speaker condition for both checkpoints.
Measure cold/warm load, peak RSS/VRAM, TTFA p50/p95, RTF, complete-wave latency, cancellation/stop behavior, and German intelligibility/content consistency.
Use the existing Trigger-7 conversation/evaluation protocol; preserve failures and OOM/timeout as bounded negative evidence.
No Trigger-4 V6 promotion from this source audit alone.
